items.title: React Simple Maps 5.0: Composable SVG Maps for React Apps
items.blurb: Create beautiful SVG map charts in React with d3-geo and TopoJSON using a declarative api.

items.title: Astryx 0.6: Meta's React Design System Gets Responsive Themes
items.blurb: Responsive theme rules, a Selector that can choose the right surface, Neutral’s visual makeover, six new templates, and a specification-backed path toward v1.

items.title: ilamy Calendar 3.0
items.blurb: A lightweight, highly pluggable React calendar component built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. A small ~13 KB gzipped core with opt-in plugins (recurring events, agenda) so you only ship what you use.

items.title: React Native Skia 2.12
items.blurb: High-performance React Native Graphics using Skia. Contribute to Shopify/react-native-skia development by creating an account on GitHub.
